description:
Default capability for the Dashboard and Workspace windows. Grants Tauri's built-in core APIs via `core:default`, the OS-notification plugin via `notification:default` (F-138 `notifications.bg_agents = os | both`), and the dialog plugin's `dialog:allow-open` permission so the Dashboard's `+ New session` modal can launch the native directory picker (F-726 follow-up, docs/ui-specs/new-session-flow.md §Empty-workspace branch).

App-local commands registered on this capability are not Tauri-gated in Tauri 2 today (only plugin commands are), but are enumerated here so that a future Tauri upgrade or capability refactor that changes gating semantics produces a reviewable diff against an explicit list:

- provider_status (dashboard only)
- session_list (dashboard only)
- open_session (dashboard only; validates the session id before creating the window — see F-063 / M11)
- session_hello (workspace-* only)
- session_subscribe (workspace-* only)
- session_send_message (workspace-* only)
- session_approve_tool (workspace-* only)
- session_reject_tool (workspace-* only)
- get_persistent_approvals (dashboard + workspace-*; F-036)
- save_approval (dashboard + workspace-*; F-036)
- remove_approval (dashboard + workspace-*; F-036)
- terminal_spawn (workspace-* only; F-125)
- terminal_write (workspace-* only; F-125, owner-label-bound)
- terminal_resize (workspace-* only; F-125, owner-label-bound)
- terminal_kill (workspace-* only; F-125, owner-label-bound)
- read_file (workspace-* only; F-122, server-cached workspace root)
- write_file (workspace-* only; F-122, server-cached workspace root)
- tree (workspace-* only; F-122, server-cached workspace root)
- lsp_start (workspace-* only; F-123)
- lsp_send (workspace-* only; F-123, owner-label-bound)
- lsp_stop (workspace-* only; F-123, owner-label-bound)
- start_background_agent (workspace-* only; F-137)
- promote_background_agent (workspace-* only; F-137)
- list_background_agents (workspace-* only; F-137)
- stop_background_agent (workspace-* only; F-138)
- delete_branch (workspace-* only; F-145)
- session_close (workspace-* only; F-747, invoked by the WindowEvent::CloseRequested hook in window_manager)

Per-window authorization is enforced in-process by `require_window_label` (F-051 / H10) or `require_window_label_in` (F-036). Bare identifiers like `allow-open-session` are intentionally omitted from the `permissions` array: Tauri 2's ACL resolver rejects identifiers that do not correspond to a compiled permission file, and Forge does not yet ship app-local permission manifests.

`notification:default` is the Tauri plugin permission set — it allows `notify` and `request-permission`, which the Status-bar badge uses to fire an OS-level toast when `notifications.bg_agents` is `os` or `both` (docs/product/ai-ux.md §4.5 / §10.6).
